leads.headline: US proposes 20% China tariff in new 14-partner duties
leads.sub: Rate stacks on ~25% existing duties across 14 trading partners; EU, Japan and Korea capped at 15% — USTR via Reuters

leads.headline: Iran's Guards say two tankers hit naval mines in Hormuz
leads.sub: Both caught fire; Tehran warned dark ships to coordinate passage; no independent confirmation — Reuters

leads.headline: Russian attack cuts power in 5 regions, halts DTEK plant
leads.sub: Across 5 Ukrainian regions; Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost external power for the 17th time this year — Reuters

small_cards.headline: Asian stocks tumble: MSCI Asia-Pacific falls 2.3%
small_cards.sub: Korea -5.3%, Taiwan -5.1%, Nikkei -2.9% at worst points; early readings, not closes — Reuters

small_cards.headline: US inflation hits 3.8%, Q3 growth revised up to 4.3%
small_cards.sub: Core PCE rose 3.3% year on year; spending rose 0.3% in October — BEA via Reuters

small_cards.headline: Houthis say they hit Ras Tanura and Riyadh
small_cards.sub: Saudis downed 4 drones; 11 wounded Tuesday in strike on same Riyadh tower — Reuters

small_cards.headline: UK energy price cap rises 26% to £2,166 a year
small_cards.sub: Ofgem rise from January hits about 20 million households on a typical dual-fuel bill — Ofgem

small_cards.headline: Israeli strike kills Hamas chief Abuelouf
small_cards.sub: Wife, 2 children killed in Beach camp apartment early Wed; 2nd senior official in 24h — Reuters

small_cards.headline: Russia's own records put Ukraine war dead at 490,334
small_cards.sub: BBC finds toll tops 700,000 with the missing; the Kremlin replied Wednesday — BBC

small_cards.headline: RSF drone attacks kill 19 in Sudan's Blue Nile
small_cards.sub: Blue Nile state: 3 Damazin neighbourhoods hit Tuesday night; 20+ wounded — Al Jazeera

small_cards.headline: Australia wins defence pact with Solomon Islands

small_cards.headline: Shenzhou-24 takes first Pakistani pilot to Tiangong
small_cards.sub: Zeeshan Ali launched 08:18 Beijing time from Jiuquan; stays 5 to 10 days — Reuters

small_cards.headline: First generic HIV prevention shots reach Zambia
small_cards.sub: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly jab, arrives in the first generic shipments — Global Fund, via Reuters
